entries.title: Romans 15:1
segments: We, the strong, ought to take on our own shoulders the weaknesses of those who are not strong, and not merely to please ourselves.

entries.title: Romans 15:2
segments: Let each of us please his neighbor for his neighbor's good, to help in the building up of his character.

entries.title: Romans 15:3
segments: Even the Christ did not please himself! On the contrary, as Scripture says of him--'The reproaches of those who were reproaching thee fell upon me.'

entries.title: Romans 15:4
segments: Whatever was written in the Scriptures in days gone by was written for our instruction, so that, through patient endurance, and through the encouragement drawn from the Scriptures, we might hold fast to our hope.

entries.title: Romans 15:5
segments: And may God, the giver of this patience and this encouragement, grant you to be united in sympathy in Christ,

entries.title: Romans 15:6
segments: So that with one heart and one voice you may praise the God and Father of Jesus Christ, our Lord.

entries.title: Romans 15:7
segments: Therefore always receive one another as friends, just as the Christ himself received us, to the glory of God.

entries.title: Romans 15:8
segments: For I tell you that Christ, in vindication of God's truthfulness, has become a minister of the Covenant of Circumcision, so that he may fulfil the promises made to our ancestors,

entries.title: Romans 15:9
segments: And that the Gentiles also may praise God for his mercy. As Scripture says--'Therefore will I make acknowledgment to thee among the Gentiles and sing in honor of thy Name.'

entries.title: Romans 15:10
segments: And again it says--'Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with God's People.'

entries.title: Romans 15:11
segments: And yet again--'Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles, and let all Peoples sing his praises.'

entries.title: Romans 15:12
segments: Again, Isaiah says--'There shall be a Scion of the house of Jesse, One who is to arise to rule the Gentiles; on him shall the Gentiles rest their hopes.'

entries.title: Romans 15:13
segments: May God, who inspires our hope, grant you perfect happiness and peace in your faith, till you are filled with this hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Romans 15:14
segments: I am persuaded, my Brothers--yes, I Paul, with regard to you- that you are yourselves full of kindness, furnished with all Christian learning, and well able to give advice to one another.

entries.title: Romans 15:15
segments: But in parts of this letter I have expressed myself somewhat boldly--by way of refreshing your memories--

entries.title: Romans 15:16
segments: Because of the charge with which God has entrusted me, that I should be a minister of Christ Jesus to go to the Gentiles--that I should act as a priest of God's Good News, so that the offering up of the Gentiles may be an acceptable sacrifice, consecrated by the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Romans 15:17
segments: It is, then, through my union with Christ Jesus that I have a proud confidence in my work for God.

entries.title: Romans 15:18
segments: For I will not dare to speak of anything but what Christ has done through me to win the obedience of the Gentiles--

entries.title: Romans 15:19
segments: By my words and actions, through the power displayed in signs and marvels, and through the power of the Holy Spirit. And so, starting from Jerusalem and its neighborhood, and going as far as Illyria, I have told in full the Good News of the Christ;

entries.title: Romans 15:20
segments: Yet always with the ambition to tell the Good News where Christ's name had not previously been heard, so as to avoid building upon another man's foundations.

entries.title: Romans 15:21
segments: But as Scripture says--'They to whom he had never been proclaimed shall see; and they who have never heard shall understand!'

entries.title: Romans 15:22
segments: That is why I have so often been prevented from coming to you.

entries.title: Romans 15:23
segments: But now there are no further openings for me in these parts, and I have for several years been longing to come to you whenever I may be going to Spain.

entries.title: Romans 15:24
segments: For my hope is to visit you on my journey, and then to be sent on my way by you, after I have first partly satisfied myself by seeing something of you.

entries.title: Romans 15:25
segments: Just now, however, I am on my way to Jerusalem, to take help to Christ's People there.

entries.title: Romans 15:26
segments: For Macedonia and Greece have been glad to make a collection for the poor among Christ's People at Jerusalem.

entries.title: Romans 15:27
segments: Yes, they were glad to do so; and indeed it is a duty which they owe to them. For the Gentile converts who have shared their spiritual blessings are in duty bound to minister to them in the things of this world.

entries.title: Romans 15:28
segments: When I have settled this matter, and have secured to the poor at Jerusalem the enjoyment of these benefits, I shall go, by way of you, to Spain.

entries.title: Romans 15:29
segments: And I know that, when I come to you, it will be with a full measure of blessing from Christ.

entries.title: Romans 15:30
segments: I beg you, then, Brothers, by Jesus Christ, our Lord, and by the love inspired by the Spirit, to join me in earnest prayer to God on my behalf.

entries.title: Romans 15:31
segments: Pray that I may be rescued from those in Judea who reject the Faith, and that the help which I am taking to Jerusalem may prove acceptable to Christ's People;

entries.title: Romans 15:32
segments: So that, God willing, I may be able to come to you with a joyful heart, and enjoy some rest among you.

entries.title: Romans 15:33
segments: May God, the giver of peace, be with you all. Amen.
